about: Reference tables the fabrication lint accepts beyond the intake. A token that is in one of these tables is real, so a brief may name it (most often in a data request) even when the intake does not carry it; the lint lists such tokens under beyond_intake so a reviewer can see them. Event IDs, service ports and TLDs were compiled from general knowledge, not yet checked against the vendor lists (Microsoft, Sysinternals, IANA); they are not exhaustive. Add a real ID here rather than weakening the lint.

excluded_tlds.about: Real TLDs the lint does not recognize as a domain ending, because file names (lessons.md, payload.zip) or dotted field paths (agent.id, decoder.name, data.win) end the same way. A domain under one of these is a known gap of the lint.
